capabilities: Filter long context menus by typing letters
Run the highlighted menu item with Enter
Navigate menu items with arrow keys
Configure the minimum menu size that triggers the filter box
extras: Requires native menus to be turned off in Settings → Appearance → Native menus (on by default on macOS); desktop only and needs Obsidian 1.13 or later. The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The README motivates it by noting that long right-click menus are slow to scan.
problem: Long context menus in Obsidian are slow to scan, and with native menus on, plugins cannot modify the menus the operating system draws.
summary: Type-to-filter box that narrows long right-click context menus in Obsidian so items can be found and run by keyboard.
